findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: Inter
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 50px on the left, 92px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 11 different lines (140px, 108px, 440px, 92px, 849px, 209px, 350px); the three most used hold only 54% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.chat-header → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(10, 14, 26) 0%, rgb(31, 41, 55) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 887px of nothing between: "Canal Renostter"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Ar-condicionado com laudo") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Trabalhos feitos" (screen 7, 100% hidden); "Canal Renostter" (screen 10, 38% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 17 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "arraste para girar · role para aproximar", "Simulador de Cores", "Gire o equipamento e toque numa cor para", "Branco Pérola"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
